name: agent-tracker
description: Live status and progress of every Cursor and Claude Code agent on this machine.

agentTracker.pingText.default: Continue where you left off. If you are blocked, say exactly what you need from me.
agentTracker.pingText.description: Message Ping sends to Claude Code sessions. Cursor chats are resumed instead, with no text.

agentTracker.tagRules.description: Extra or overriding tag rules: tag name to a case-insensitive regex, e.g. {"data": "\\b(dbt|bigquery)\\b"}.

agentTracker.onlyWork.description: Only show sessions started with a /work command or skill.

agentTracker.stalledMinutes.description: A turn with no transcript activity for this long shows as stalled.

agentTracker.prices.description: Extra or overriding USD-per-1M-token prices keyed by model prefix, e.g. {"claude-opus-5-5": {"input": 4, "output": 20, "cacheHit": 0.05}}.

agentTracker.worktreeCleanupScript.description: Script run as `<script> --worktree PATH` to remove an agent's worktree. `builtin` runs the same checks with git directly, on any OS. A custom script must refuse (exit 2) when the worktree has uncommitted or unpushed work. Empty disables worktree cleanup.

agentTracker.cleanDoneWorktreesAfterMinu.description: Remove a done task's worktrees once it has been quiet this long. 0 disables cleanup for done tasks; Kill still cleans up.
